1.explanation: The Button component in Button.js declares its kind prop using PropTypes.oneOf(ButtonKinds). The ButtonKinds array (from prop-types/types) does not include the string "danger-ghost", so passing that value fails validation. The component’s className logic already handles any kind by interpolating the string into the CSS class (e.g. btn--danger-ghost), and the tests in Button-test.js even check for kind="danger-ghost". To fix the warning, the allowed values for kind must be updated — either by adding "danger-ghost" to the ButtonKinds export in prop-types/types or by extending the PropTypes.oneOf list in Button.propTypes to include "danger-ghost".
1.bug_scenario: When rendering the Button component in Storybook with kind="danger-ghost", React emits a prop-type warning saying that "danger-ghost" is not one of the allowed values for the kind prop, even though the component and its tests clearly expect to support a "danger-ghost" variant. The warning appears in the browser console when you add a story that uses <Button kind="danger-ghost">Danger Ghost</Button>.

2.explanation:
The root of the warning is in packages/react/src/components/Button/Button.js: the Button component’s propTypes for `kind` is defined as PropTypes.oneOf(ButtonKinds), and ButtonKinds (imported from '../../prop-types/types') is missing the string 'danger-ghost'. Although the component’s className logic (`
`${prefix}--btn--${kind}``) and tests expect a "danger-ghost" variant, the prop-type validation rejects it. To fix the issue, add 'danger-ghost' to the ButtonKinds array (or directly into the oneOf list) so that PropTypes.oneOf(...) recognizes it as a valid kind.
2.bug_scenario: When rendering a “Danger Ghost” button in Storybook (kind="danger-ghost"), React issues a prop-type warning: it doesn’t recognize “danger-ghost” as a valid kind. The console screenshot shows “Invalid prop `kind` of value `danger-ghost` supplied to `Button`, expected one of […].” This happens because the Button component’s PropTypes.oneOf list (ButtonKinds) doesn’t include “danger-ghost”, even though the component and its CSS support that variant.
